title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 367 (Certificate of registration of existing companies)

content.overview: On compliance with the requirements of this Chapter with respect to registration, and on payment of such fees as are payable under section 403, the Registrar shall certify under his hand that the company applying for registration is incorporated as a company under this Act, and in the case of a limited company that it is limited, and thereupon the company shall be so incorporated.
content.glance: On compliance and fee payment, Registrar issues certificate of incorporation under this Act; company is thereupon incorporated.
